en.primary_text: Silvicom Inc is hiring Class A regional drivers for dry van runs in the Midwest. Earn $1,600–$1,900 per week and get home weekly. Health, dental, and vision insurance included. 2 years experience and age 23+ required.
en.headline: Home weekly. Up to $1,900/wk.

es.headline: A casa cada semana.
